acceptance_evidence.AC1_workshop_convene_and_list: WorkshopSessionView renders WorkshopDeliberativeMeetingsSection allowing a trader to pick participants from the eligible list including the trader's own private servant (with M9 cap <= 5), convenes deliberative meetings via POST /bff/agora/workshops/:id/meetings with Idempotency-Key, and lists the meetings convened by the session
acceptance_evidence.AC2_committee_gate_panels_and_deliberati: CommitteePage lists both gate panels (session_class=gate_panel) and deliberative meetings (session_class=deliberative_meeting) with class filters, every round (independent Round 1 and anonymised cross-visibility Round 2 with revised position badges, confidence, and citations), chair synthesis, non-binding tally, and dissent memo
acceptance_evidence.AC3_unsponsored_agora_candidate_decision: Proposals without a trading-persona sponsor (sponsor_persona_id=null / approval_path=agora_candidate_decision) are displayed as Agora candidate decisions with their approval status and can be routed on the existing candidate-decision approval path (POST /bff/agora/meetings/:meetingId/proposals/:proposalId/candidates) with execution_authority=none
acceptance_evidence.AC4_component_tests_and_existing_tests: StrategyWorkshopPage.test.tsx (61 tests) and learning.pages.test.tsx (21 tests) cover workshop convening, refusal reasons (persona_user_mismatch, servant_absent, insufficient_participants, participant_budget_exceeded), gate panels, deliberative rounds/synthesis/dissent, and unsponsored Agora candidate decisions against recorded BFF responses
